assessment.diversity_evidence: All twelve stories share the same broken-tap garden problem. Three causal variants appear: sunflower first with a brown-leaf consequence (s000014, s000023, s000021, s000034), seedlings first followed by watering the sunflower after repair (s000036, s000048, s000002), and equal water with shared umbrella shelter and repair deferred (s000028, s000058, s000017, s000053, s000057). Wording and outcomes repeat closely within each variant, so the sample shows little overall diversity.
